scope: Read-only review of final native PCB power/charge-temperature placement; no routing or thermal validation claimed.

charger_thermal_placement.finding: No through-hole connector or other footprint occupies the exposed-pad area. Nearby capacitors and setting resistors leave the package bottom available for a designed thermal-via pattern. No thermal-via/heat-spreading qualification is claimed.

temperature_separation.finding: Temperature comparator/filter cluster is in the lower quiet region near NTC terminal, away from main converter inductor and EPD switching stage; no major placement move indicated.

requirements: Route IN13-C101-GND and OUT10/11-C102-GND as short/wide local loops, battery2/3-C103 equally local.
Connect VSS8 and exposed pad17 to GND; do not rely only on exposed pad as the VSS connection.
Design thermal-via array/copper spreading to ground layers; use assembly-approved filled/tented via/paste arrangement to avoid solder loss.
Keep ISET/ITERM/TMR/TS low-current ground returns free of high-current battery/OUT return drops; join locally to the ground structure without severing the system plane.
L1/9 to L201.1 and L2/7 to L201.2 align without crossing; preserve short, wide copper and minimum switching-node area.
VIN/C201 and VOUT/C202 require immediate local GND return paths; use solid reference plane and adjacent ground vias.
Keep AGND/control return quiet relative to PGND power-loop return, join close to device; do not add a split ground moat through signal return paths.
Kelvin-style feedback takeoff from C202 positive /3V3_REG before R203, route to R201/R202/FB away from L1/L2 and inductor.
The present DLA footprint uses numbered PGND pad8; no fabricated extra center-pad net may be introduced.
C204 closes the VDD3-GND4 bypass locally.
Sense BAT_PROT from protected battery/R102 downstream node with a quiet branch; return gauge ground to battery ground without sharing avoidable high-current trace drop.
Maintain separate test/disconnect R217/R218 and preserve source-side AON pullup topology.
C203 pin1 must connect directly to VCC24 with a close ground via on pin2.
Fan out control and I2C traces with continuous GND reference; route pullups without long decoupling stubs.
C901 bypass at V+8 to GND4 via a low-inductance local ground connection.
Keep BAT_NTC and HOT/COLD reference traces short and away from power switching nodes; place filter ground vias locally.
R907/R908 are intentional feedback; avoid extra capacitive coupling by not running comparator output/CHG_TS parallel to NTC/reference inputs.
Use a quiet ground return for NTC terminal/filter/reference network; exclude charge/discharge current from this return segment.
At each U401-U405, input capacitor must have a short direct VIN/GND connection, CT capacitor a short quiet CT/GND connection.
Route VOUT through measurement jumper to output capacitor/load; preserve QOD resistor connection on the load side of measurement jumper.
Use load-current-rated power width and GND returns; QOD branch does not become isolated merely by removing measurement jumper.

limitations: Distances are pad-center straight-line measurements, not routed length or loop inductance.
No thermal simulation, charging test, via design, copper fill, impedance or current-capacity validation.
Global final silkscreen/DRC evidence is recorded by parent review; this report checks power placement only.

final_native_recheck.scope: Final native PCB recheck after parent silkscreen-only finish; no project modification.
